                 cs_item_sk item_sk,                  cs_wholesale_cost wholesale_cost           from   catalog_sales           union all           select ws_sold_date_sk sold_date_sk,                  ws_bill_customer_sk customer_sk,                  ws_item_sk item_sk,                  ws_wholesale_cost wholesale_cost           from   web_sales          ) cs_or_ws_sales,          item,          date_dim,          customer  where   sold_date_sk = d_date_sk          and item_sk = i_item_sk          and i_category = 'Sports'          and i_class = 'camping'          and c_customer_sk = cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk          and d_moy = 6          and d_year = 2001          and wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48          and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1932 AND 1945  )  , my_revenue as (  select c_customer_sk,         sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as revenue  from   my_customers,         store_sales,         customer_address,         store,         date_dim  where  c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk         and ca_county = s_county         and ca_state = s_state         and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk         and c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk         and ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48         and s_state in ('IA','MD','MO'                     ,'MS','NE','NY'                     ,'OK','TN','TX'                     ,'VA')         and d_month_seq between (select distinct d_month_seq+1                                  from   date_dim where d_year = 2001 and d_moy = 6)                            and  (select distinct d_month_seq+3                                  from   date_dim where d_year = 2001 and d_moy = 6)  group by c_customer_sk  )  , segments as  (select cast((revenue/50) as int) as segment   from   my_revenue  )   select  segment, count(*) as num_customers, segment*50 as rewritten_query:
with qualifying_sales_customers as (
    select cs.cs_bill_customer_sk as customer_sk
    from   catalog_sales cs
           join date_dim d
             on cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
           join item i
             on cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    where  d.d_year = 2001
      and  d.d_moy = 6
      and  i.i_category = 'Sports'
      and  i.i_class = 'camping'
      and  cs.cs_wholesale_cost between 18 and 48
    union
    select ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    from   web_sales ws
           join date_dim d
             on ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
           join item i
             on ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    where  d.d_year = 2001
      and  d.d_moy = 6
      and  i.i_category = 'Sports'
      and  i.i_class = 'camping'
      and  ws.ws_wholesale_cost between 18 and 48
),
my_customers as (
    select c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_current_addr_sk
    from   customer c
           join qualifying_sales_customers q
             on c.c_customer_sk = q.customer_sk
    where  c.c_birth_year between 1932 and 1945
),
month_bounds as (
    select min(d_month_seq) + 1 as start_month_seq,
           min(d_month_seq) + 3 as end_month_seq
    from   date_dim
    where  d_year = 2001
      and  d_moy = 6
),
my_revenue as (
    select c.c_customer_sk,
           sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) as revenue
    from   my_customers c
           join customer_address ca
             on c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
           join store s
             on ca.ca_county = s.s_county
            and ca.ca_state = s.s_state
            and s.s_state in ('IA','MD','MO','MS','NE','NY','OK','TN','TX','VA')
           join store_sales ss
             on c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
            and ss.ss_wholesale_cost between 18 and 48
           join date_dim d
             on ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
           cross join month_bounds mb
    where  d.d_month_seq between mb.start_month_seq and mb.end_month_seq
    group by c.c_customer_sk
)
select segment,
       count(*) as num_customers,
       segment * 50 as segment_base
from (
    select cast(revenue / 50 as int) as segment
    from   my_revenue
) segments
group by segment
order by segment, num_customers
limit 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replace the wide UNION ALL over catalog_sales/web_sales followed by DISTINCT on (customer_sk, address) with a UNION of only cs_bill_customer_sk/ws_bill_customer_sk after pushing item/date/wholesale-cost filters into each branch. Since c_customer_sk is a primary key, deduplicating customer keys before joining customer is equivalent and much cheaper.

Replace the two scalar subqueries computing d_month_seq+1 and d_month_seq+3 from date_dim with a single month_bounds CTE using MIN(d_month_seq). June 2001 has one month_seq, so this is equivalent and avoids two separate InitPlan scans.
Convert comma joins into explicit INNER JOINs and push single-table filters (s_state IN (...), ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN) into the join conditions for clearer and potentially better join ordering.
Inline the trivial segments CTE as a derived table, computing cast(revenue/50 as int) directly; no materialization needed.
